content:
Elena: Quick ask 12 — our new manager for Customer Reliability (hybrid) joins Mon. Id like a slimmed-down manager+HR checklist, a one-paragraph first-week agenda I can paste into the offer email, and a simple 30/60/90 outcomes list. Also who owns parking pass & lab access?

Jonah: Congrats! Short version below. Ill also attach a calendar template if you want. :tada:

Jonah: Manager+HR micro-checklist (one-line items):
- Preboard: confirm laptop model, Okta invite, GitHub + Slack add, submit I-9
- Day 1 AM: People Ops intro (benefits, payroll steps) + quick paperwork sign-off (20m)
- Day 1 mid: Manager intro (role goals + 30/60 expectations) (30m)
- Day 1 PM: IT/dev access sweep (VPN, repo, CI tokens)
- Day 2: Pair with buddy for env setup and tiny verify task
- Day 3: Security & facilities short touchpoints
- End of week: 30m sync to capture blockers & define 30-day success metric

Jonah: Who to ping:
- Parking/office badge: @Marcus (facilities) or facilities@redwood.internal
- Lab/secure room access: Marcus + facilities approval form
- KMS/VPN: @Keiko (security) or #security-ops
- Repo/org access: eng-admin channel or me

Marcus: I can handle parking & badge. For hybrid folks we give a QR desk pass and an annual visitor badge; need a local phone number. If theyre traveling first week, note preferred days.

Keiko: Security note: for any KMS or staging secrets, we need a manager-signed AUP. I can make a temporary dev-only role for day 1-14. Also recommend scheduling the 20-min "safeguards & safe dev" intro in week 1.

Elena: Nice. Can you give me a one-paragraph first-week agenda thats short and candidate-facing?

Jonah: Sure, paste this: 

"Welcome week (short): Day 1: People Ops intro and manager welcome; mid-day IT/access check and a light team lunch. Day 2: paired dev env setup with your buddy and run the onboarding smoke test. Day 3: short security & facilities orientations. Day 4: time to complete a small hands-on task (first PR or infra tweak) and schedule initial 1:1s. Day 5: 30-minute wrap with your manager to align on 30-day priorities."

Jonah: 30/60/90 outcomes (high-level bullets to include in offer email):
- 30 days: stable access, merged first small change, clear 1:1 rhythm and documented handoff notes
- 60 days: leading a small reliability improvement (spec -> deploy), improved runbook(s), baseline metrics captured
- 90 days: delivering a cross-team initiative, onboarding checklist updated, mentoring new hires

Elena: Can the onboarding task be something infra-y but safe? I dont want to risk staging creds.

Jonah: Yeah: clone repo, run `./ci/verify.sh` locally (no secrets), fix a README section or add a comment to a runbook, open PR. That validates GH + CI without touching secrets.

Marcus: I've reserved a QR desk pass for the first two onsite days. Will DM for phone number and local address.

Keiko: If they need staging KMS later, well do manager approval + short form and give a time-limited role; will rotate creds after 30 days.

OnboardingBot: New hire created: "Customer Reliability Manager 1 start 2026-04-20". Assigned tasks: Elena (manager), Jonah (people-ops), Marcus (facilities), Keiko (security). Welcome email scheduled. Link: https://hr.redwood.internal/onboard/CRM-2045

Elena: Perfect. Ill send the paragraph and 30/60/90 bullets to the candidate. Marcus  Ill reply with onsite days. Keiko  Ill DM the signed AUP if KMS needed. Thanks all! :pray:
